prompt: You have brought snacks to share with a group, and you remember that one friend has a serious nut allergy. What is the most caring thing to do?

options.text: Serve the nut snacks anyway — your friend can just not eat them
Keep the nut snacks sealed and separate, tell your friend clearly which foods contain nuts, and make sure there are safe snacks they can eat
Say nothing, so your friend does not feel singled out
Ask your friend to sit away from the group while everyone eats

explanation: For someone with a serious food allergy, even traces of the food can cause a severe reaction. Keeping allergen foods separate, labelling them honestly and providing safe alternatives protects your friend and keeps them included.
